race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
race.verdict: HENRIETTE RONNER ran better than for a while when second at Nottingham in July and, having since joined a yard which does well with new recruits, she could be ready to take advantage of her reduced mark. 5-time C&D winner Tomorrow Day arrives in good form and is feared most, ahead of Lord Abama . HENRIETTE RONNER TOMORROW DAY LORD ABAMA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Tomorrow Day (9/2), Lord Abama (5/1), Multaneighttothree (11/2), Believe In Lies (7/1), Reenie's Dream (7/1), Teardrops (8/1), Henriette Ronner (10/1), Yaaser (14/1), Kilfrush Blue (16/1), Snuggle (16/1), Ramon Di Loria (25/1), Orbital Chime (25/1), Triple P (25/1), Teddy Shaw (33/1)
